Timeline.title: A strong past, a stronger future.
Timeline.introText: Since 1994 we've been shaping a body of expertise in natural stone and surface solutions. We removed the middlemen, source raw materials directly from 14 countries, and export to 12 countries — Germany leading the way.
Timeline.y1994Desc: Yapı Granit's journey began in 1994. Founded with big dreams in a small workshop, our company aimed for quality from day one.
Timeline.y2000Desc: Moving to our current headquarters and the trust we earned from our customers enabled 300% annual growth.
Timeline.y2004Desc: We removed the intermediaries. We started sourcing granite raw materials directly from quarries and factories in 14 different countries worldwide.
Timeline.y2005Desc: We crowned our growth by exporting to Germany. We now provide not just material supply but project-based service — bringing complex structures to life.
Timeline.y2015Desc: With our 5-Axis CNC, Waterjet and Bridge Saw machines we elevated our production infrastructure to space-industry standards.
Timeline.y2026Desc: Exporting to 12 countries, with 3000+ completed projects and 32+ years of accumulation — an engineering brand processing stone from Denizli to the world.
